senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָדָה I)that which is carried or put on, cloak, ornament.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 9:1">Esth. R. to V, 1</cite> <he>ע׳ תפארתה</he> her cloak of state.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 9:1">Ib.</cite> <he>סומכת עֶדְיָהּ</he> supporting her cloak (trail); a. e.—Pl. <he>עֲדָיִים</he>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24b:17">Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>מפוארת בעדי ע׳</he> adorned with the choicest ornaments.
